description: Food-at-Home Monthly Area Prices is published by USDA Economic Research Service. F-MAP reports monthly unit-value prices and price indices by food category and area. Its stated coverage is United States; 90 food categories across 15 geographic areas. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through listed XLSX resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. Unit values and price indices are different measures and should not be combined without their definitions. For simulation, it can inform food-supply demand, capacity or disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record data-global-food-twin-food-flows provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
